title: Some docker-compose shipped by the project exposes by default Webadmin REST API publically without… (CVE-2026-74756)
description: Certain docker-compose files shipped by the project expose the Webadmin REST API publicly by default without proper authentication. Starting with version 3.9.1, the project mitigates this by setting a random credential on unprotected Webadmin endpoints to prevent unauthorized access while maintaining convenience.
